title: GetUserInfo dumps full PII (name, address, email, phone) into LLM context
owner_hint: no CODEOWNERS entry; top committer: Stephen Toub / Eric Erhardt; component: WebApp/
rationale: Data-minimization at the tool boundary: GetUserInfo now serializes only the display-name claim; the eight address/email/phone fields are deleted before they ever enter the model context, so prompt-injection steering (e.g. via f015's render sink) cannot exfiltrate data that is not present. [Description] updated so the model's expectation of the tool contract stays truthful. Tool-call invisibility and third-party egress remain inherent to the LLM integration (mitigated only by not sending PII at all).
variants_checked: GetCartContents returns product data keyed to the caller (no claims PII); SearchCatalog/AddToCart return no claims; no other claim readers enter LLM context.
bypass_considered: Repeated/parameterized tool calls yield only the name; other tools never touch _user.Claims; f015's exfil channel is reduced to the display-name residual.
test_note: Omitted — tests/ has no WebApp test project and nothing references ChatState/Chatbot; adding one exceeds minimal-diff scope.
review_reason: Root-cause data minimization at the exact serialization site, sole caller verified; keeping only the least-sensitive claim is the minimal-claim-set variant; no new surface.
